按你的习惯，安静地工作: Quietly, just the way you like
每轮低电量只提醒一次。耳机仅显示电量。: One alert per low battery episode. Headset alerts are off.
只控制电量浮窗，更改时需要管理员授权。: Controls only the battery overlay. Changes need administrator approval.
设置无法保存，请检查目录权限: Could not save. Check folder permissions.
奥创更新后存在两份组件，暂不更改: Two overlay copies found. No changes made.
耳机按 0–8 档换算，显示近似电量；耳机不发送低电量提醒。: Headset battery is estimated from levels 0–8. No headset alerts.
奥创电量浮窗已经关闭，无需重复操作: The battery overlay is already disabled.
无法读取操作结果，请检查浮窗组件状态: Could not read the result. Check overlay status.
等待超时，可重新打开设置查看状态: Timed out. Reopen settings to check status.
设备响应超时，已停止本次读取；请唤醒设备后刷新: Device timed out. Wake it and refresh.
读取进程无法启动，请稍后重试: Could not start the reader. Try again.
耳机未开机或超出连接范围: Headset is off or out of range
电量接口被占用，请稍后重试: Battery interface is busy. Try again.
耳机未回复，请检查基站连接: No headset reply. Check the base station.
设备返回无效电量: Device returned an invalid battery level
鼠标休眠或未连接，请动一下鼠标后刷新: Mouse is asleep or offline. Move it and refresh.
无法创建设备读取锁: Could not create the device read lock
设备正在被另一窗口读取，请稍后刷新: Another window is reading this device. Try again.
无法写入查询命令，请关闭占用设备的程序后重试: Could not send the query. Close apps using the device and retry.
设备未回复，请唤醒设备并检查连接；如有占用请退出 Armoury Crate 后: No reply. Wake the device and check its connection; if busy, close Armoury Crate and retry.
未找到支持的接收器/USB 接口，请检查连接（不支持蓝牙）: Supported receiver/USB interface not found. Check connection (Bluetooth is unsupported).
管理员授权已取消或未获批准，设置未更改: Administrator approval was cancelled or denied. No changes made.
请在 EXE 版本中启用开机启动: Enable launch at sign in from the EXE version
已恢复并启动奥创电量浮窗: Armoury Crate battery overlay restored and started
原程序和备份同时存在，可能是奥创已更新；为保留文件，本次未更改: Original and backup both exist, possibly after an update. No files changed.
未找到奥创电量通知组件: Armoury Crate battery component not found
未能验证关闭结果: Could not verify that the overlay was disabled
未找到可恢复的通知组件: No notification component available to restore
大疆接口被占用，请退出其他麦克风控制软件: DJI interface busy. Exit other mic control apps.
检测到多个大疆接收器，暂不支持选择: Multiple DJI receivers: selection not supported yet
电量条仅示意档位，并非精确百分比；麦克风不发送低电量提醒。: The bar illustrates a battery category, not an exact percentage. Microphone alerts are disabled.
显示设备回报的真实设置: Showing settings reported by the device
设置会影响实际音频。立体声与安全音轨互斥；免拔插外放会重启接收器。: Settings affect actual audio. Stereo and safety track are mutually exclusive. Plug-free speaker reboots the receiver.
更改免拔插外放会重启接收器并短暂中断音频。是否继续？: Changing plug-free speaker will reboot the receiver and briefly interrupt audio. Continue?
设备未就绪，请等待有效状态回报: Device not ready. Wait for valid status.
当前固件或设备不支持此设置: Setting unsupported by this firmware or device
设置发送失败，请检查连接: Setting could not be sent. Check the connection.
设置超时，未获得确认的设备回报: Timed out without confirmed device status
设置失败，设备未确认更改: Setting failed; device did not confirm the change
设备返回非成功 ACK，设置未确认；可能受固件能力限制: Device returned a non-success ACK. Setting unconfirmed; firmware capability may be limited.
此接收器的降噪写入受固件限制，仅显示设备回报状态。: This receiver limits noise cancellation writes. Reported state is shown read-only.
降噪 USB 指令被设备拒绝；可双击麦克风电源键切换降噪。: The device rejects USB noise cancellation commands. Double-press the microphone power button to toggle it.
